caveats: Sea cells = finite on all target days; land/partially-NaN cells are 0 in mask. Threshold/climatology from 1992-2002 pools with +-5 day windows (edge days 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 included). Day-of-year uses leap-style mapping (Feb29=60). The single event begins on 2021-06-01, the first target day, so its true onset may precede the target window and is truncated by the analysis window; no days outside 2021-06-01..2021-08-31 were used for MHW detection.
